name: Squarespace
one_liner: Website builder with Commerce REST APIs (orders, products, inventory, transactions, contacts, discounts, webhooks).
auth_notes: API key (Bearer) generated per site, or OAuth 2.0 authorization code with Basic-auth client credentials; access token valid 30 minutes, refresh token one-time use, expires after seven days. Scoped to one website.
access_notes: API keys need a Commerce Advanced plan site. OAuth client registration is reviewed by Squarespace before client_id/secret are issued; Extensions listing is a separate process.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST APIs; OAuth needs reviewed client registration and key access needs a paid Commerce Advanced site. Rate limit 300 req/min.

auth.quote: access_token is only valid for 30 minutes.
The refresh token expires after seven days.

access.quote: We will review your registration and respond with your_client_id and your_client_secret as soon as possible.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.

api_surface.quote: Webhook Subscriptions API: Subscribe to notifications from a site, like when an order was created, by configuring a webhook endpoint.
Squarespace Commerce APIs employ a rate limit of 300 requests per minute

buildability.quote: the Create Order endpoint has a separate, stricter rate limit of 100 requests per hour, per website when an API Key is used

disputes.why: Third-party OAuth clients are reviewed; paid plan applies only to site-owner API keys. Both gates documented.
Multi-tenant integration must use OAuth, which requires reviewed client registration.
Overview lists nine API groups; 20-100 endpoints plausible, not counted.
Rate limits page states 300 requests per minute.
FAQ documents dynamic cursors for collections.
